new-neighbor.title: Meeting a new neighbor.
signature: Hello. My name is Omar. What's your name?
I'm Sara. This is my first day in the neighborhood.
Welcome! That is the library across the street.
Is there a place to buy bread nearby?
Yes, there is a bakery next to the library.

cafe-order.title: Ordering at a café.
signature: Good morning. What would you like?
I'd like to order a cup of tea, please.
Would you like some milk with your tea?
No, thank you. Can I have some water as well?
Of course. You don't have to pay until you leave.

find-the-platform.title: Finding the platform.
signature: Excuse me. Do you know where the train leaves from?
It leaves from platform three. This is the way to the platforms.
Do I have to show my ticket here?
You can show it on the train. You need to be there before ten.
Thank you. I think I have enough time.

study-together.title: Planning a study session.
signature: I want to practise English before the exam.
I have to work this afternoon. Can I meet you tomorrow?
Of course. We need to bring our notebooks.
It's worth reviewing the difficult examples first.

a-new-routine.title: An old habit and a new routine.
signature: I used to take the bus to work every day.
How do you get to work now?
I usually walk. It takes twenty minutes to get there.
I managed to walk to work twice this week.
That's a good start. Let's walk together on Monday.

market-budget.title: Shopping on a budget.
signature: How much do these tomatoes cost?
These are three dollars a kilo. Would you like a bag?
I bought a bag yesterday. I only need two kilos today.
Let me weigh them for you.

clinic-desk.title: An appointment at the clinic.
signature: I feel tired, and I need to see a doctor.
I'd like an appointment this afternoon.
There is an appointment at three. You should arrive ten minutes early.

project-meeting.title: Moving a project meeting.
signature: Could you please move the meeting to Thursday?
I think Thursday will work because the team is free.
Let me know if the time changes.
I'll send you a message. We don't have to book a new room.

library-book.title: Borrowing a library book.
signature: Do you know if the library is open today?
Yes. There are two copies of your book on that shelf.
Of course. Could you please show me your library card?

family-weekend.title: A family visit at the weekend.
signature: Would you like to visit our grandparents this weekend?
I used to visit them every Friday. I want to see them again.
Let's take some fruit with us.
It's worth leaving early so we can spend more time with them.

missed-bus.title: After missing the bus.
signature: I missed the bus because of the rain.
Is there another bus stop nearby?
There is one near the school, but it takes ten minutes to walk there.
Let's walk there. I prefer walking to waiting here.

phone-help.title: Help with a flat battery.
signature: I forgot to charge my phone.
Would you like to use my charger?
Thank you. Can I use your phone for a moment?
Of course. Let me show you where to plug in the charger.

meal-plan.title: Planning lunch.
signature: Would you like some rice for lunch?
I prefer soup to rice today.
There are four of us. Let's make enough for everyone.

museum-entrance.title: Finding the museum entrance.
signature: Excuse me, where is the entrance to the museum?
That is the main entrance, just past the garden.
Can I buy a ticket there?
Yes. There is a ticket desk just inside.

shared-table.title: Sharing a table.
signature: Excuse me, do you mind if I sit here?
Not at all. This is the only free seat.
Thanks. Is it okay if I charge my phone here?
Of course. There is an outlet under the table.

lesson-time.title: Confirming the lesson time.
signature: When is the next English lesson?
The class starts at nine tomorrow.
Do you have the room number?
Yes, I have it here. I'll send it to you.

missing-coat.title: A coat left on the bus.
signature: Did you leave your coat on the bus?
I didn't take it with me when I got off.
Do you know where the lost property office is?
Yes. I'll call the office and give them the bus number.

forgot-receipt.title: Returning an item without a receipt.
signature: I'd like to return this bag. I forgot to bring the receipt.
I need a receipt or the order number.
Can I show you the confirmation on my phone?
Yes. Let me check the order number.

bicycle-saturday.title: Fixing a bike on Saturday.
signature: Are you going to use your bike this weekend?
I'm going to repair it first. I need a new tire.
Can you bring the wheel to my place on Saturday?
Yes. If the shop is open, I'll bring a tire too.

quiet-room.title: Asking for a quieter room.
signature: Would you mind lowering the music a little?
Of course. I'm sorry for playing it so loudly.
That's all right. I have an online lesson in five minutes.
I'll use my headphones until your lesson is over.

help-with-boxes.title: Helping with some boxes.
signature: Can you hold the door while I carry this box?
Of course. How many boxes are there?
There are three. I'll carry the small ones first.
Let's leave the heavy one until we're both free.

rainy-picnic.title: A backup plan for the picnic.
signature: Are you going to the park tomorrow?
I might go, but the weather doesn't look good.
If it rains, I'll make lunch at home instead.
Good idea. Let me know if you need anything.

first-day-office.title: Clarifying the first task.
signature: Could you clarify the instructions for my first task?
Please check the names on this list today.
So I have to check the names today. What about the phone numbers?
I'll check the phone numbers tomorrow. You can leave those to me.
Thanks. I don't have to wait to send the list, then.

shoe-size.title: Trying a different shoe size.
signature: Is there a larger size in these shoes?
Yes. I'll bring you the next size up.
Can I try these shoes on?
Of course. There's a bench by the mirror.
These fit much better. I'd like this pair, please.

fruit-for-guests.title: Fruit for the guests.
signature: Six. These are the oranges we bought last week. We need a few more.
Two dollars a kilo. Let's get a kilo and put out the apples too.

card-payment.title: Paying by card.
signature: Yes. Please tap your card here.
Thanks. I need a receipt for this purchase.
Let me print one for you.

bread-before-closing.title: Bread before closing.
signature: Is there any fresh bread left?
There is one loaf left. Would you like me to put it aside?
Yes, please. When is closing time?
The shop closes at six. I'll keep it behind the counter until then.

wrong-size-online.title: The wrong size arrived.
signature: I bought a jacket online, but the one that arrived is too small.
A medium. I didn't order a small. Could you please check the order number?
You're right. I'll arrange an exchange. Let me know if the return label doesn't arrive by email.

charger-included.title: Does it come with a charger.
signature: That's for charging. Both devices use the same kind of cable.
Which one is cheaper? How much is the smaller one?
It's ninety dollars. The larger one is one hundred and ten.
Does the smaller one come with a charger?
Just a cable. I have a compatible charger here if you need one.

parcel-pickup.title: Picking up a parcel.
signature: Excuse me. I'd like to pick up a parcel.
It's for Omar Ali. Here's the pickup code.
Thank you. May I see your ID as well?

printer-quote.title: Getting a printing quote.
signature: How much does it cost to print in black and white?
Ten cents per page. How many pages do you need?
Twenty. Could you please tell me whether I need to bring a USB drive?
You don't have to bring one. Just email us the file and we'll print it for two dollars.

faulty-kettle.title: A kettle that stopped working.
signature: Did you try plugging the kettle into another outlet?
I did, but it still wouldn't turn on. I didn't try opening it.
I'm sorry for the trouble. I'll ask our technician to check it this afternoon.
Thank you. Here's my number. Please call me before replacing anything.

gift-budget.title: Choosing a gift on a budget.
signature: I want a gift for my sister. I can spend fifteen dollars.
Which one would she use more, a notebook or a book?
I usually prefer notebooks to books as gifts, but she reads every night.
Then this short novel might suit her. It costs twelve dollars.

tailor-pickup.title: Picking up a garment.
signature: When is the earliest I can pick up the trousers?
I can finish the hem tomorrow afternoon.
As soon as they're ready, I'll come by.
I'll text you before five. Let me know if you need to come the following morning instead.

bus-stop-directions.title: Directions to the bus stop.
signature: Excuse me, where is the bus stop?
See the building across the road? That is the school.
Should I cross at the lights?
Yes. There is a bus stop just past the school gate.

direct-airport-train.title: A direct train to the airport.
signature: Are there any direct trains to the airport?
Yes. The next one leaves at seven.
Does it leave from this platform?
No. You have to go to platform three, but you stay on that train all the way.

seat-on-train.title: A seat on the train.
signature: Are there any free seats in this carriage?
There are two by the window.
Can I put my bag on the rack?
Sure. Do you mind if I take the window seat?
Not at all. I'll take the aisle seat.

hotel-checkin.title: Checking in at the hotel.
signature: Good evening. My name is Omar Ali, and I have a reservation.
Welcome. May I see your passport, please?
Of course. Where is the elevator?
Just past the lobby on your right. Your room is on the second floor.

bus-or-walk.title: Taking the bus or walking.
signature: How much is the bus fare?
Two dollars. It takes ten minutes to get there by bus.
I prefer walking to taking the bus if we have time.
We've got half an hour. Let's walk along the river.

wrong-gate.title: A gate change.
signature: Is there a departure screen near here?
There's one by the stairs. Do you know where your flight is boarding?
I didn't see the gate change on my phone. It still says twelve.
They changed the gate, so you need to go to twenty. It's just down this hall.

two-tickets.title: Two ferry tickets.
signature: I'd like two tickets for the ferry, please.
Tomorrow. I want seats together if possible. How much are the tickets?
Eight dollars each. I have two seats together by the window.
The ferry leaves at noon tomorrow.

calling-a-driver.title: Arranging a pickup.
signature: It's outside the main entrance. Could you please wait near the blue sign?
Sure. I'm meeting my brother at the airport at six, so I need to leave by five.
When I get there, I'll call you. I should be at the sign by five.

map-without-signal.title: Using a map without a signal.
signature: I can't load the map. There's no signal here.
I can explain the route without a map. We turn left at the next crossing.
Let me write that down before we move.
If we see the library, I'll know we're on the right road.

bag-at-station.title: A bag at the station.
signature: I've got a blue bag with a gray strap.
This is the one we found near the platform. Does it look familiar?
Yes. The bag that I left has a name tag inside. Could you check it?
It says Omar Ali. You can take it now.

delay-announcement.title: Understanding a delay announcement.
signature: Could you clarify what the announcement said?
The train is delayed because of a signal problem.
Could you tell me whether my ticket is valid on the next train?
Yes. This train won't run, so we'll accept your ticket on the next one.

early-alarm.title: An early alarm.
signature: I wake up at six. What time does your alarm go off?
At six too, but I get up as soon as it rings.
I usually stay in bed for ten more minutes.
I take the bus to work every day, so I can't do that.

before-school.title: Before leaving for school.
signature: What do you do first in the morning?
I brush my teeth first. Then I get dressed.
Do you eat at home or on the way to school?
I have breakfast at home. Before I leave, I check my bag.

after-work.title: After work.
signature: What do you do after work?
After I finish work, I go home and change clothes.
Do you stay home for the rest of the evening?
I sometimes go for a walk. On Thursdays, I go to the library.

weekend-sport.title: Weekend exercise.
signature: On weekends, I often run before breakfast.
Why do you go so early?
It's quieter. I never run at noon because the park is too hot.

night-routine.title: Getting ready for bed.
signature: What do you do at night before bed?
I always set my alarm first. Then I read a little.
Do you finish the book in one evening?
No. It's usually quiet by nine, so I go to bed then.

breakfast-choices.title: Choosing breakfast.
signature: Would you like eggs or oatmeal for breakfast?
I like eggs, but I don't like oatmeal.
Do you want any fruit with the eggs?
Yes, please. I eat an apple most mornings.

find-the-key.title: Looking for the key.
signature: Where is the key to the front door?
I saw it beside your notebook this morning.
I've got the notebook here, but the key isn't under it.
Wait. That is your key on the hook by the door.

lend-a-pen.title: Borrowing a pen.
signature: Do you have a pen I could use?
Yes, I have a spare blue one.
Can I borrow it to fill in this form?
Thank you. I'll give it back in a minute.

window-or-fan.title: The window or the fan.
signature: Is it okay if I open the window? It's warm in here.
I think the street is too noisy. Would you mind turning on the fan instead?
That's fine. I prefer a little noise from the fan to the traffic outside.
Great. The low setting should be enough.

dinner-ingredients.title: Ingredients for dinner.
signature: How many people are we cooking for?
Six. There are four potatoes in the cupboard.
I need two more for the soup.
Let's get a small bag of potatoes and use the rest tomorrow.

first-aid-supplies.title: First-aid supplies.
signature: What is in that small red bag?
Just a few supplies for the class.
Where is the first-aid kit, then?
There is one in the cupboard by the door.
Could you please bring it to the desk?

class-introduction.title: Introductions on the first day.
signature: Hi. My name is Omar. What's your name?
I'm Sara. I'm a new student here.
So am I. Who is the woman by the board?
That's our English teacher. Class is about to start.

repeat-instructions.title: Asking for instructions again.
signature: Could you please repeat the last instruction?
Sure. Write two examples, then exchange your paper with a partner.
Could you clarify which part we check for each other?
Let me show you. Check that the verb comes after the subject.
Thank you for showing me. I'll check the word order first.

quiet-study-place.title: Finding a place to study.
signature: I need a quiet place to study. Is there a library near campus?
Yes. There is a small library behind the main building.
Where do you usually study there?
On the second floor. It's quieter than the entrance hall.

group-presentation.title: Dividing up a presentation.
signature: I can make the slides, but I can't stay late to rehearse.
I can do the introduction. We still need someone for the conclusion.
I must leave by four, but I can write a short conclusion now.
Good. Let's rehearse the whole presentation at three.

teacher-office-hours.title: Meeting the teacher.
signature: May I come by to ask about my essay?
Of course. My office hours are on Tuesdays.
When is the first slot on Tuesday?
At ten, but I'm meeting another student then. I can see you at eleven.
I'm afraid I can't come at eleven. Would noon work?
Yes. Bring your draft and we'll go through it together.

report-deadline.title: The report deadline.
signature: The first draft is due on Friday. The final version is due next week.
So I have to finish the draft this week. Could you please send me the checklist?
I'll send it now. You don't have to add the charts until the final version.

book-recommendation.title: Recommending a book.
signature: I'm interested in hiking. Do you know any books for beginners?
The book that I borrowed last week has some easy routes.
Does it tell you what to bring?
Yes. It lists useful items such as a torch and a map. It's worth reading before your first trip.

practice-club.title: An English practice club.
signature: Would you like to join our English practice club?
I'd love to. What do you do at the meetings?
I usually bring a short dialogue. This week I'm planning to practise ordering food.
How about taking turns as the customer and the server?
Good idea. I'll bring a menu we can use.

online-lesson-audio.title: Trouble hearing the online lesson.
signature: I can't hear you clearly. Could you please repeat the last sentence?
Let me check the microphone. Can you hear me now?
Yes. I didn't catch the first part because the sound cut out.
I'll start the sentence again and write it in the chat too.

exam-mistake.title: Understanding a test mistake.
signature: Did you see why you lost a point on question three?
I didn't understand what it meant by “give one reason.”
What I mean is that you gave an example, but you didn't say why it mattered.
I see. I should have explained the reason in a full sentence.

study-methods.title: Choosing a study method.
signature: How do you remember the phrases you learn?
I prefer saying them aloud to copying them out.
In my opinion, it helps to hide the text first.
Exactly. For example, I look at a picture, say a sentence, and then check the original.

last-shift.title: What happened on the last shift.
signature: Were you at reception when the delivery arrived?
I was in the back office. I was checking the order list.
When the driver arrived, Noor signed for them and called me.

missed-message.title: A missed message.
signature: Did you get my message about the meeting?
I didn't see it. While I was helping a customer, my phone was in a drawer.
We moved the meeting to tomorrow morning.
I'm sorry for missing the update. I'll check my messages at lunch next time.
That's all right. You still have time to read the notes.

old-and-new-job.title: From the old job to the new one.
signature: I used to work in a small shop near my house.
How did you find your new job?
I went to a careers fair and I met the manager of a hotel there.
No. I started working there the following month.

equipment-repair.title: Repairing equipment.
signature: Did you find out why the printer kept jamming?
Yes. I decided to check the back because the front tray was clear.
Was there any paper stuck back there?
A torn sheet was stuck inside, so I removed it with the power off. I managed to print a test page afterwards.

welcoming-intern.title: Welcoming an intern.
signature: This is Sara, our new intern.
Hi. I'm here for two weeks. Who is in charge of the schedule?
Lina is the person who plans the shifts. She sits by the window.
Thanks. I'll go and introduce myself.

new-procedure.title: A new office procedure.
signature: Please save each order as a PDF before you send it.
Could you clarify where to save the file?
Use the shared folder so that the whole team can find it.
Should I put the date in the file name?
Yes. Add the date to make older orders easier to find.

meeting-followup.title: Following up after a meeting.
signature: Will you send everyone the meeting notes?
Yes. I'll send them before lunch. Could you check the dates?
Of course. As soon as I check them, I'll message you.
Thanks. Let me know if any of the deadlines have changed.

safety-check.title: Checking equipment before use.
signature: I must check the guard before I switch the machine on, right?
Yes. And you should keep the checklist where you can see it.
Do I need to print a new copy every day?
You don't have to print another copy unless the instructions change.
Understood. I won't start the machine if the guard is loose.

workshop-choices.title: Choosing a workshop.
signature: I think we should choose the afternoon workshop.
I don't agree with that suggestion. Half the team is on shift then.
Fair point. What matters is that everyone can attend.
I agree with you on that. Let's ask for a morning session next week.

new-deadline.title: Negotiating a new deadline.
signature: Can you send me the report by Thursday?
I might need another day. I expect to finish the figures by Thursday afternoon.
Friday is fine, but I need the summary before the meeting at ten.
If I get the figures early, I'll send the summary on Thursday evening.

launch-feedback.title: Feedback after a launch.
signature: How do you feel about the first week of the new service?
I'm happy with the response. I'm surprised that so many people used it on the first day.
I'm disappointed that we had to turn some people away. The waiting area was full.
I agree. I appreciate your suggestion to offer more appointments next week.

tea-with-a-guest.title: Offering tea to a guest.
signature: Would you like tea or coffee?
I'd like a cup of tea, please. I like it without sugar.
Here you are. It's hot, so be careful.
Thank you for making it. It smells lovely.
You're welcome. Please help yourself to a biscuit.

visiting-grandmother.title: Visiting Grandma.
signature: Are you going to visit Grandma on Saturday?
Yes. I'm going to take her some lunch. What time is the first bus?
The bus leaves at seven in the morning, but there's another at nine.
I'll take the nine o'clock bus.
Great. I'll call Grandma and tell her when to expect you.

changing-a-visit.title: Rescheduling a visit.
signature: Are we still on for this afternoon?
I'm afraid I can't make it. I'm sorry for changing the plan at the last minute.
That's all right. We can meet tomorrow.
I'm not going to be home tomorrow morning. How about coming after lunch?
That works. See you at two.

joining-the-group.title: Joining the group.
signature: Do you mind if I join your group?
Not at all. You may sit here. We're planning a walk on Saturday.
That sounds fun. Where will you meet?
At the park gate. Would you like to come with us?
I'd love to. What time should I be there?

a-friend-feels-tired.title: A friend feels tired.
signature: I feel tired. I'm worried about getting everything done before dinner.
Which task is most urgent? I can help with the others.
The shopping can wait. I should take a short break before I finish the report.

family-memory.title: Remembering a family day.
signature: These are the photos from Grandma's party.
I remember the day when we all surprised her. I had the camera ready by the door.
When she walked in, everyone started clapping.
And I made the cake you can see in this photo. She asked for another slice.

finding-the-playground.title: Finding a place to play.
signature: Where is the playground near the library?
It's the place where we met after class last week. That is the entrance across the road.
Yes, two. Let's cross at the lights and walk in together.

friend-s-new-hobby.title: A friend’s new hobby.
signature: What do you do in your free time these days?
I'm interested in photography. I've been practising in the park.
The photos you sent are lovely. I'm proud of how much you've improved.
Thanks. I hope to put together a small album by the end of the month.

shared-celebration.title: Preparing a celebration.
signature: Would you like to have dinner out for your birthday?
I don't feel like going out. I don't like crowded restaurants on Fridays.
How about making dinner at home instead of eating out?
That sounds good. I feel like making a pizza, and we can invite a few friends.

thank-you-for-help.title: Thanking a helpful neighbor.
signature: Thank you for helping me carry those boxes upstairs.
You're welcome. I'm glad I got home in time to help.
I'm grateful for your help. I wouldn't have managed the big box alone.
It was no trouble. I appreciate you lending me your cart last week, too.

keeping-the-plan.title: Keeping the plan.
signature: I may get there late if the bus is delayed again.
Even if you're late, we'll still have time for the walk.
Although the path might be wet, I'd still like to go.
Me too. I'll probably bring a spare pair of socks, just in case.

office-signup.title: Signing up for a workshop.
signature: I'd like to sign up for the Saturday workshop.
Sure. Do you have an account on our website?
Not yet. May I register here instead?
Yes, just fill in this form.
Thanks. When is the deadline to hand it in?
Five o'clock today. You can leave it with me when you're done.

community-room.title: Booking a community room.
signature: I wonder if the community room is free on Friday evening.
It is, but someone has asked to use it until five.
I wonder how we can book it for six. Could you tell me whether we need to pay in advance?
No payment is due until the day. Fill in this form, and let me know if you need the chairs set out before six.

team-options.title: Choosing a project solution.
signature: I believe a short online form is the quickest way to collect feedback.
I don't agree with using an online form alone. Some visitors don't have internet access.
Printing separate forms would take more time. However, we could leave one tablet at reception.
Good idea. In addition to the tablet, let's keep a few paper copies for anyone who needs one.

testing-assumptions.title: Testing an assumption.
signature: Why is the printer so slow? It seems like the network is down again.
It sounds like a network problem, but let's try printing a test page without the network first.
The test page is slow too. The reason is that the printer is set to its highest quality.
That's why it took so long. Let's use the standard setting for these drafts.

supporting-a-claim.title: Supporting a claim with examples.
signature: In my opinion, we should give new staff a short checklist for their first week.
Routine tasks such as booking a room and sending a receipt. For example, a new starter could use it to see who approves a booking.
That would not only save time but also reduce mistakes. Let's try it with the next group.

competing-priorities.title: Balancing competing priorities.
signature: While a quick release would help customers today, a full review would catch more errors.
Even though the draft looks good, we haven't checked the prices yet.
What matters is that people see the correct prices.
Then let's check the price list now instead of publishing the whole page immediately.

before-the-departure.title: What happened before departure.
signature: I heard you nearly missed the train. What happened?
I had already packed my bag before my ride arrived. But I wasn't ready to leave because I couldn't find my ticket.
Did you find it in time?
Yes, in my jacket. By the time we got to the station, boarding had already started.
So how did you make it?
The conductor said, “I'm about to close the doors.” I showed him my ticket just in time.

if-we-had-called.title: If we had called first.
signature: The hall was locked when we arrived. If we had called first, we would have known it was closed.
I'm sorry for assuming it would be open. I should have checked the opening hours.
We could have met at the library instead. It stays open late.
I'll call the hall tomorrow. If it's still closed, we'll book a table at the library.

imagining-a-solution.title: Imagining a different solution.
signature: I wish I could find a quiet room for our study group. The usual room is full.
If I were you, I would ask the librarian about a room upstairs.
Even if there's no room, we could use two small tables near each other.
Good idea. If you ask about the room now, I'll look for tables.

improving-with-practice.title: Getting better with practice.
signature: I keep forgetting new phrases. How much time do you spend reviewing them?
It takes about ten minutes to review five phrases. The more I use them in conversation, the easier they are to remember.
I think I can fit that in after lunch. Could we practise together on Fridays?
Yes. Let's each bring one new situation so that we can use the same phrases in different ways.

food-plan-alternatives.title: Alternatives for guests.
signature: Would you like rice with the soup, or bread?
Rice, please. I don't eat bread unless it's gluten-free.
We've got plenty of rice. In addition to the soup, we can make a salad.
Great. I need two more cucumbers for the salad. I'll get them on my way home.
